business_problem: The team faced the challenge of integrating various data types seamlessly, as the AI needed to process both speech and data from the patients' Electronic Health Records (EHR).
solution_summary: Doctolib built its Microsoft solution to improve document-heavy expert workflows. The team faced the challenge of integrating various data types seamlessly, as the AI needed to process both speech and data from the patients' Electronic Health Records (EHR). Key components included Azure OpenAI Service ran model inference or heavy processing, and Azure AI Studio coordinated workflows, prompts, or deployment. User prompts and domain content are orchestrated through Azure AI Studio, processed by Azure OpenAI Service, and then delivered through Azure OpenAI Service so Doctolib can return context-aware answers or automation in the flow of work. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft. With 1 million healthcare practitioners and 90 million patients using their platform across Europe, the company is now at the forefront of AI to go one step further in delivering on their promise.

solution_components.role: Runs large language models that generate grounded responses, summaries, and copilots.
